channel.title: Indranil Biswas
channel.description: ML engineer building agents and graph ML. Writing and prototypes.

item.title: Same Bot, Two Games
item.description: A language model lost to a two-ply chess bot. A four-ply alpha-beta search behind the same harness mated it in 17.

item.title: The Harness Is the Product
item.description: What building an agent harness from scratch taught me about the part of the system that is not the model.

item.title: What Two GPUs at Home Taught Me
item.description: An idle GPU, a power supply that was too small, and an engine that was not the problem.

item.title: Two Stores, One Truth
item.description: Four of my five worst pipeline bugs were the same mistake: keeping state in a database and in files.

item.title: Four Results I Had to Retract
item.description: An empty database file, a reward made of flakes, a spec that broke my output, and a warning in my code that nobody had tested.

item.title: My Stateful Memory Made the Fuzzer Worse
item.description: A one-run win, a ten-run loss, and what telling a language model what not to do actually does.
